# Propagation crown pixel evidence

These fixtures are original-size upper tile strips cropped from 61 user-supplied opened Runeshape recipe panels received on 2026-10-11. The 251 strips retain the nearby recipe border, tile frame and supporting pixels below each tile. No strip is resized, enhanced or padded. Each manifest crop box is checked against the actual panel bounds before saving.

Three independent visual labeling passes recorded 263 physical, complete crown marks, zero naturally partial marks and zero uncertain marks. Socket positions are one-based and reflect visible crown tips, not gold or blue frames alone, recipe-family inference, source filenames, CSV labels or detector predictions. These source panels alone cannot establish accuracy on naturally partial crowns. Any later synthetic partial-mark evaluation must be identified separately from this natural-image set.

The manifest records each source filename, SHA-256 of the originally supplied source image, source dimensions, crop box, visible row label and manually observed crown socket positions. Geometry is approximate and expressed in saved-strip pixels. Source-image SHA-256 values identify originals before panel cropping; they are not hashes of the strip PNGs. Recipe text may be clipped while its socket row and physical marks remain fully visible; readable recipe text is not a prerequisite for labeling crown geometry.

Pre-opening remnant evidence is excluded. This fixture concerns propagation marks only and does not train or change remnant scan recognition. Pair25 row 1 includes the independently reverified full crown at socket 9 as well as socket 5; the manifest retains the visual correction audit note.
